# ojw fixtures

`wn-kaw.tab` — a real 23-row slice (header line + rows verbatim) of
github.com/davidmoeljadi/OJW's one data file (master, retrieved
2026-09-01): the abrĕsih block (three senses + the mabrĕsih derived
form, the 4-column shape), six more 4-column rows, and the
pracima/prabh* block (multi-synset lemmas). License CC BY 4.0 (in-repo
LICENSE; the tab's own header repeats it).
